title: Add --help flag to pystore CLI
summary: Implement a CLI tool for pystore that supports the --help flag to display usage information and available commands. This requires creating the CLI module from scratch as it currently does not exist.

approach.description: Create a new CLI module using Python's argparse library which provides built-in --help flag support out of the box. The CLI will expose key pystore operations like listing stores, collections, and items, as well as basic management commands.
approach.reason: argparse is part of Python's standard library and provides automatic --help flag generation with proper formatting and usage examples

implementation_steps.description: Create pystore CLI module with argparse

changes.change: Create CLI module using argparse with main entry point function. Include subcommands for: list-stores, list-collections, list-items, info, delete-store, delete-collection, delete-item
Create module entry point that imports and calls cli.main()
Implement each subcommand to call appropriate pystore library functions (list_stores, store().list_collections(), collection().list_items(), etc.)

cli_commands.description: Display help message with all available commands
List collections in a specific store
Show item metadata and schema information
Delete a store and all its data
Delete a collection and all its items
Delete a specific item from a collection

test_strategy.description: Add tests for CLI functionality in tests/test_cli.py

test_cases.description: Test that --help flag displays usage information
Test that CLI properly handles missing required arguments
Test that CLI displays error for unknown commands

risk_1.description: CLI module might conflict with library namespace
risk_1.mitigation: Use separate cli.py module to avoid importing conflicts

risk_2.mitigation: Use subprocess to test installed CLI or test cli.main() function directly

estimated_files_to_change.changes: New file with ~80-100 lines for CLI tests

backward_compatibility: Full backward compatibility - this adds new CLI functionality without modifying existing library code
